_comment: Qwen2.5-7B FULL fine-tune on 1x A100 80GB — optimized for ~5 hour completion
_hardware_notes: A100 is ~2.5x slower than H100 for 7B training
Full 1 epoch = 9,264 steps = ~8 hours on A100
max_steps=4500 caps training at ~5 hours (sees ~72K of 148K samples = 49%)
Remove max_steps for full epoch (~8 hours) for best quality
batch_size=8 to fit in 80GB VRAM (model+optimizer ~60GB, ~20GB for activations)
Effective batch size: 1 GPU x 8 batch x 2 accum = 16
